points: IEEE recently released the IEEE Xplore AI Research Suite , built on the full text of millions of peer-reviewed publications in the IEEE Xplore Digital Library .

Researchers who use the AI suite to search the digital library receive answers grounded in verified scientific results, ensuring a high level of accuracy and trust.

points: This post builds enterprise agentic retrieval on a Managed Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Base with the AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK).
To see why that’s worth building, it helps to start with where ordinary Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) breaks down.
Most RAG systems start the same way: they embed the question, fetch the nearest chunks from one index, hand them to a model, and return the answer.
